import logging, io

def make_logger(level):
    stream = io.StringIO()
    handler = logging.StreamHandler(stream)
    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(levelname)s:%(message)s"))
    log = logging.getLogger("lesson.demo." + str(level))
    log.handlers.clear()
    log.setLevel(level)
    log.addHandler(handler)
    log.propagate = False
    return log, stream

log, stream = make_logger(logging.WARNING)
log.debug("d")
log.info("i")
log.warning("w")
log.error("e")
print(stream.getvalue().strip())

import logging, io

stream = io.StringIO()
handler = logging.StreamHandler(stream)
handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(levelname)s:%(message)s"))
log = logging.getLogger("lesson.parse")
log.handlers.clear()
log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
log.addHandler(handler)
log.propagate = False

def parse_all(values):
    good = []
    for v in values:
        try:
            good.append(int(v))
        except ValueError:
            log.error("skipping %r", v)
    log.info("parsed %d of %d", len(good), len(values))
    return good

result = parse_all(["4", "x", "10", "3.5"])
print(result)
print(stream.getvalue().strip())
